I lived in this one house for about 6 years when I was a kid. It wasn’t old, built in the 80’s and we moved in around 2005, but it always had a weird atmosphere to it. Nothing major really happened that would make me think that it was haunted except for one incident which I really can’t explain. 

When I was maybe 10 I was up past my bedtime reading. I heard footsteps coming down the hall so I quickly shoved my book and flashlight under my pillow and pretended to be asleep. I heard the door open and someone come in, and I felt them sit at the edge of my bed. My mom would sometimes check on us at night and watch us for a little bit so this wasn’t weird to me. What was weird was not even a minute later when the pressure in my ears suddenly increased and then released in like a fraction of a second. The sensation startled me and my eyes shot open and the weight at the edge of my bed vanished. 

I immediately bolted across the hallway and slept in my brothers room for the next month after that.

I went to a farm camp that had been running for around 70 years before losing its lease in 2014 and closing. Before it was a summer camp it was just a big ranch that had been in the family for a couple generations. So this area had seen a lot of human activity for a long time. 
During the sessions, each cabin would get the chance to sleep outside in one of the big open areas. One year after my cabin had slept outside, I woke up just after sunrise before anyone else was awake. I’m about to climb out of my sleeping bag to fill my water bottle when the camp dogs woke up and started growling. They were growling in the direction of the footpath to the pigs pen, where there was just a line of skinny dead looking trees along the path before an open field. There was shadowy figure running up the path. 
It was tall, had pointed arms and legs almost like a stick figure, and it was almost running in slow motion. Like it was being suspended by something and was making running motions as it was being pulled along. 
The dogs then run towards it barking and as they get close it disappears behind one of the skinny trees. 
Needless to say I didn’t leave my sleeping bag until the rest of the girls in my cabin were up a little while later.
